text:
Olivia: FYI — ACME Corp reported a bank transfer posted yesterday but our autopay reconciliation flagged it as unreconciled. Amount: $38,400. Invoice INV-2026-0189. Customer says payment sent from their AP on 2026-02-12.

Jenna: Can you paste the payment advice or a screenshot of the wire confirmation? We need the bank reference / remittance info to match.

Olivia: Pasting the customer's confirmation they sent (redacted):

```
Payment confirmation (ACME Bank)
- Value date: 2026-02-12
- Amount: 38,400.00 USD
- Ordering customer ref: ACME/INV/789
- Beneficiary reference (for payee): <blank>
- Ordering bank ref (SWIFT UETR): 4f6d-3a2e-9b1c
- Payer note: PO4421
```

Mike: We match on the "Customer ref" / invoice number in the beneficiary reference. If that's blank it drops to suspense. Do you have the raw ledger export line for the incoming transaction (the exact string we received)? Could be a formatting issue.

Olivia: Customer insists they put "PO 4421" in their AP comment. Their email shows: "PO 4421" but bank field looks like "PO4421" in their remittance. I pulled the ledger line from the payments feed: 

```
transaction_id: 20260212-9982
amount: 38400.00
currency: USD
beneficiary_reference: "PO\u20134421"
credit_account: US-REDFWD-001
```

Andrew: That \u2013 sequence is interesting — looks like a non-ASCII dash (unicode 0x2013 or similar). Our reconciliation normalizer currently only replaces ASCII hyphen-minus (0x2D). If the incoming string used an en-dash or non-breaking space it wouldn't normalize to "PO-4421" or "PO4421".

Mike: If it's \u2013 then our fuzzy match won't pick it up. Short term: we can manually reconcile this to the invoice. Long term: we need to strip/unify unicode dash characters and collapse whitespace.

Olivia: Manual reconciliation request submitted to GL, holding here until finance confirms. Customer needs this cleared today to avoid late-fee escalation.

Andrew: I'll push a small change to the payments matcher to normalize unicode dashes and weird spaces. Test on staging now. Patch is minimal: strip Unicode [\u2010-\u2015] and NBSP, replace with '-'. Also run a one-off re-match on yesterday's suspense bucket.

payments-bot: Deploy request created (#deploy-1768509800) by Andrew for branch/payments/unicode-normalize.

Jenna: Please mark as high priority. ACME asked for confirmation for their AP team.

Mike: I ran the manual credit in GL and posted the reconciliation entry. Documented suspense resolution: CP-2026-0217.

Andrew: Staging run found 4 other transactions with similar unicode dashes; re-match succeeded. I'll schedule prod deploy in ~2 hours after approvals.

Olivia: Confirmed with ACME AP — they see invoice marked paid on their side. I'll send them the reconciliation reference and close the ticket. :white_check_mark:

Mike: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- Andrew: prod deploy normalization + one-off re-run on last 7 days (PR open).
- Olivia: send reconciliation ref to ACME and close the support case.
- Jenna: monitor for any more hits from the same payer/bank.

Olivia: Closing once I get final prod deploy confirmation.
